name: Replimune Group
verdict: WATCH-ONLY into the AdCom/PDUFA binary — DEFINED-RISK event, no established positive edge vs the priced coin-flip; DEFAULT = NO PRE-POSITION
catalyst: FDA AdCom late-Jul-2026 (exact date UNVERIFIED) then PDUFA goal 2-Aug-2026; RP1+nivolumab advanced melanoma; accelerated approval on single-arm IGNYTE
note_probs: Joint p(favorable AdCom AND approval) ~0.40-0.50 — NOT a naive coin flip UP: third attempt, unchanged single-arm evidence base, an AdCom convened specifically to air an adequacy/contribution-of-components objection the FDA already raised twice. Bear tail (CRL/negative vote) = distressed going-concern raise into a crushed stock -> back toward the 52wk-low regime ($1.50-$3). Bull = accelerated approval de-risks a first/only post-PD-1 oncolytic, but confirmatory IGNYTE-3 overhang remains.
e_fv: ~10.7 (0.45*22 + 0.55*1.5 ~ 10.7) — approximately the live $10.00; the market is pricing the binary near fair. This is the crux: NO EDGE at spot.
market_implied: Analyst targets span $1 to $17 (BMO $16 Outperform vs Wedbush $9 Neutral, low $1); annual IV ~328%. The $1-to-$17 dispersion IS the binary priced explicitly. Options-implied move (Aug-21 straddle) pending API — expect >~60-80%.
edge_type: NONE established (fairly-priced binary). Honesty-axis = CLEAN (going concern + CRL history + single-arm limitation all disclosed). The catch is asymmetry, not a lie — so this is NOT a honesty-alpha short either.
mechanism_falsifier: If the FDA/Oncology Center had signaled a changed evidentiary bar (e.g. accepting single-arm + a strong confirmatory design as sufficient), or if the AdCom voting question were framed narrowly on safety/benefit-risk rather than substantial-evidence adequacy, the base rate would shift toward YES. Absent that, the same objection that produced two CRLs is unresolved.
entry_band: WATCH-ONLY. No naked pre-AdCom long. IF (against doctrine default) any pre-position were ever taken it must be DEFINED-RISK (long premium / call spread), UNLEVERED, sleeve-capped <=0.5% NLV, and only if a positive edge is demonstrated — which it is NOT here. CANDIDATE envelope for the principal, post-event: see resolution pack.
kill_triggers: AdCom votes NO on substantial evidence / benefit-risk -> CRL near-certain -> avoid; do NOT catch the knife until a financing or strategic (partner/sale) path clears the going concern
Even on a YES vote: a hostile briefing-doc release (FDA posts its review 2 biz days pre-AdCom) can gap the stock down before the vote — the briefing doc is the real leading tripwire
Any dilutive raise announced pre-vote (ATM is live) caps upside and signals management hedging
tripwires_leading: FDA briefing documents posted ~2 business days before the AdCom (the single most informative pre-event signal — FDA's own read of the data)
Federal Register notice fixing the exact AdCom date + the verbatim voting question(s)
Any 8-K on financing (ATM draw, PIPE) or on RP1 regulatory status

court_record.mode_b_decisive: The AdCom does NOT turn on the ORR number (33.6% is real and durable, 24.8mo DoR). It turns on whether a SINGLE-ARM trial can be substantial evidence of effectiveness for a COMBINATION where RP1's isolated contribution is unproven — the exact objection in both prior CRLs. The resubmission adds no randomized data; IGNYTE-3 (confirmatory, RCT vs physician's choice) is not yet read out. So the FDA's scientific objection is structurally unchanged; the third attempt bets on a post-leadership-shakeup FDA and melanoma-community pressure, not new evidence. That is a REGULATORY-JUDGMENT bet, not a data bet.
court_record.mode_a_verified: CONFIRMED from primary: (1) PDUFA goal 2-Aug-2026, accelerated-approval sought, AdCom 'late July' [8-K EX-99.1 26-Jun-2026]. (2) Cash+STI $268.9M, burn $280.3M FY26, runway into cal-Q1-2027, audited GOING CONCERN [10-K repl-20260331]. (3) Cap structure: no converts, no preferred issued, pre-funded warrants (penny) already in share count, Hercules $80M term loan balloon Oct-2027 [10-K]. (4) Shares 82.7M [10-K].
court_record.honesty_grade: CLEAN. Every load-bearing risk (single-arm limitation, two prior CRLs, going concern, dilution need on a NO) is disclosed in plain language in the company's own filings. Marketed takeaway ('risk/benefit discussion', 'urgency') does not diverge from the data — the data and the risk are both on the table. Not a honesty-alpha catch.
court_record.mode_b_reviewer_split: The decisive Mode-B refinement from the CRL#2 8-K: this is NOT a clean data-failure. FDA's clinical reviewers accepted contribution-of-effect; FDA LEADERSHIP overruled them. The ODAC bet = will external experts + post-shakeup leadership side with the reviewers? That is why the binary is priced ~coin-flip, not doomed. BUT the base objection (single-arm adequacy) is unchanged and an AdCom is a public forum where a skeptical panel can still vote no — the reviewer-split cuts the bear probability but does not eliminate it.

designation: BTD (granted, anti-PD-1-failed IGNYTE cohort); original BLA 21-Nov-2024. BTD did not prevent 2 CRLs — bull reads promise, bear reads correctly that a marketing designation does not answer a substantial-evidence objection. Melanoma patient advocacy (AIM at Melanoma) engaged = a real countervailing bull factor at ODAC.
crl2_primary: CRL#2 dated 10-Apr-2026 (8-K 13-Apr, EX-99.1): objection is PURELY substantial-evidence/contribution-of-effect — NO new CMC deficiency. KEY BULL NUANCE (company disclosure): the FDA's own BLA CLINICAL TEAM 'thought the applicant had provided adequate evidence to support contribution of effect of RP1 plus nivolumab but LEADERSHIP did not agree'; a new review team was appointed for the resubmission and did not meet with the company. So the third attempt is a bet on whether an EXTERNAL ODAC panel sides with the clinical reviewers (who were convinced) over prior FDA leadership — closer to a coin-flip than 'twice-rejected=doomed', which is why spot is $10 not $3. CEO: 'without timely accelerated approval, the development of RP1 will not be viable' + eliminated jobs / scaled back US manufacturing => a CRL#3 is likely TERMINAL for the program as structured (raises the bear severity toward the $1.5 floor).
